body: The Northern Mariana Islands are a United States overseas territory, counted as the US for country streaks.
The Google car is fully blurred except for an antenna at the front right that is noticeably closer to the camera than Guam’s.
Poles are usually wooden with a crossbar at the top, unlike Guam’s typically concrete poles.
Northern Mariana Islands use blue street signs, whereas Guam uses green.
The islands have a tropical climate with dense and somewhat low vegetation.
The Flame Tree (Royal Poinciana) with a wide crown and bright red flowers is the territory’s official tree and very common; it is rare in Guam.
Both Northern Mariana Islands and Guam feature a large number of road reflectors.
East Asian languages such as Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and Russian are commonly seen here, also common in Guam.
Car coverage exists only on the main island of Saipan; northern islands lack coverage, while Tinian and Sinapalu have only tripod coverage.
Dense commercial areas occur on the southern half of Saipan’s west coast.
Suicide Cliff is a steep cliff with exposed rock near the island’s northern tip.
